messages:
kate: Quick sync — we're targeting an EU model swap next Wed 11:00 UTC. Need a rollout + fallback plan for hosted + dedicated customers. Who can own the canary gating and runbook? cc @mihir @sam

mihir: I can own the canary orchestration. Proposal: staged slices for region EU only — 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100%. 30m bake between stages, 1h monitoring window after 20%.

sam: Telemetry gates we should enforce: p95 latency < 200ms, error rate < 0.5% (5xx + decode failures), and quality regression on our smoke eval < 1% absolute. If any gate trips, auto-roll back to eu-model-v1.

tia: Feature flag plan: single flag with discrete stages and a kill-switch. Example config:```
ff.eu_model_v2_swap:
  stages:
    - name: stage-1
      percent: 1
      duration: 30m
    - name: stage-2
      percent: 5
      duration: 30m
    - name: stage-3
      percent: 20
      duration: 60m
  kill_switch: true
  fallback: eu-model-v1
```

ben: Sales asks: reserved/dedicated customers should be able to opt-in/opt-out. We need a per-tenant override and a flag in the tenant UI. Also a short note to CSMs so they can set expectations.

kate: Good — add shadowing: can we shadow traffic to v2 for dedicated tenants for 24h before slicing live traffic? Prefer to catch perf/quality issues without affecting end users.

mihir: Yes. Shadow config: shadow 10% of dedicated tenant requests (sampled across tenants) for 24h. If shadow logs show kernel OOMs or >2x latency, abort.

sam: Runbook snippet (short):
- Gate failure: if p95 >200ms for 10m -> pause rollout and revert to eu-model-v1.
- Quality alert: if eval regression >1% at stage boundary -> pause and run deeper eval.
- OOM/infra: immediate rollback and capacity bump request to SRE.
- Owner on-call: @sam initial revert, @mihir investigate perf.

tia: A/B testing note: for prompt-tuning changes we should limit experiments to non-PCI tenants and opt-in cohorts only. We can run an A/B for default prompt set in stage-3 (20%) to validate response quality.

ben: Also need a commercial guardrail: an API param that forces fallback for tenant-level SLA customers. Pls ensure Dedicated has a hard flag that always prefers eu-model-v1 if set.

deploy-bot: Job created: canary-deploy/eu-model-v2-5812345678, shadow-group=dedicated-sample-10, scheduled for 2026-04-08T11:00:00Z.

kate: Questions for sign-off: 1) Owners confirmed (mihir/sam), 2) Feature flag name (tia) 3) Telemetry dashboards and alerting wired up (sam) 4) Sales/CSM comms ready (ben). Can we finalize this by EOD Friday?

mihir: I'll drop the rollout playbook into the console (routes + flag YAML) and link it here by Friday EOD.

sam: I'll create the dashboard + alerts and add the automatic rollback script to the canary job.

tia: I'll name the flag ff.eu_model_v2_swap and add tenant override keys.

kate: Sweet — agreed. Final call: EOD Friday; if anyone sees a missing blocker speak now. :thumbsup:
